verification_harness_findings: Successful SQLx queries exceeding the one-second diagnostic threshold are counted separately from analytics failures; ZP2 had one 1.883-second completed query during its verification window.

Journal capture requests complete fields and decodes byte arrays before counting.

unrelated_findings.finding: Signal CLI startup configuration requests can be refused on localhost:8083; startup evidence is retained and this is separate from analytics health.

Network membership consistency warnings occur at startup on existing data; baseline examples precede deployment on Skhid, CBR and Kupiansk.

Legacy candidate-route warnings say postgres_fallback on hosts without analytics; final diagnostics correctly record successful primary operations with reason=unconfigured. Warnings were retained.
The standard maintenance wakeup iterated 10,433 session-set members; deployment completed without changing session data or the lifecycle.
Earlier rollout observations included Delta EXO login/account-configuration errors; no such error occurred in the final fleet-audit window.
